[[Entangling Roots]] are large plants of the [[Maguuma Jungle]]. When they are under attack, they can create a wall of roots, preventing anybody to come closer, or flee, while they are still alive. When they create their wall, some [[Moss Scarab]]s or [[Life Pod]]s usually [[popup]] from the ground nearby, to make the fight more uncomfortable. When they die more Moss Scarabs can [[spawn]].
